summary: Bly, OR: 1934 warehouse-roof platform, then a 20-ft tower at the Forest Service station; tower dismantled 2007, cab moved to Bly City Park.

facts.design: 20-ft wooden tower with a 7x7 flat-roof cab; only the cab survives
facts.status_note: Only the cab survives, at Bly City Park; the 20-ft tower was dismantled in 2007 and the original site is listed as Tower Gone
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Fremont National Forest (Bly Ranger District)

access.note: Cab stands in a city/community park in Bly; no source describes visiting hours or entry

events.note: Klamath Forest Protective Association platform on a warehouse roof at its Bly station; not the later tower
20-ft wooden tower with 7x7 flat-roof cab built at the Forest Service compound (register build field says 1950)
Structure decommissioned; scheduled for removal to a local park as an interpretive center
Cab moved to the city/community park in Bly
Former site registered May 17, 2011 as US 1008, OR 366

evidence.quote: In 1958, a 20 foot wooden tower with a unique 7x7 flat roof cab, with catwalk, was constructed at the Bly, U.S. Forest Service, Ranger Station.

evidence.quote: located a short distance to the east of the Forest Service Station

evidence.supports: 1934 platform on a warehouse roof at the Klamath FPA station
evidence.quote: The original lookout in Bly was a platform on the roof of a warehouse at the Klamath FPA station in 1934.

evidence.supports: Klamath station closed in the mid-1950s; Forest Service erected a 20-ft wooden tower
evidence.quote: When this station was closed in the mid 1950s, the Forest Service erected the 20' wooden tower in their compound

evidence.quote: the small cab from the 1950's 20' wooden tower was remove from the ranger station, and moved to a city park in Bly, Oregon

corrections.current: undated 'None relocated' entry (Moved from Bly Ranger Station to Bly City Park.)
corrections.proposed: remove; keep the dated 2007 relocation entry
corrections.why: Duplicates the 2007 relocation, has no year, and adds nothing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's build field gives 1950, but its description and the Forest Lookouts page both give 1958 for the 20-ft tower. The 1934 platform predates both. We report 1958 for the tower.

notes_for_editor: The record's 'standing' status and 'ground' kind refer to the relocated cab, not a tower. Access is unverified beyond the park location; no source describes entry. The condition of the cab in 2026 rests on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list and could not be checked further. The 2007 chapter report says the cab was moved, not the tower. The 1950 vs 1958 build year is a source conflict; the story reports both.
